options.name: additional_devices
options.description: Defines to add/remove virtual volume to expand

options.name: cache_invalidate
options.description: To perform cache invalidate on the virtual volume

options.name: debug
options.description: To specify whether to have debug statements from vplexapi in log file or not

options.name: expand
options.description: Defines to perform expand operation for virtual volume

options.name: new_virtual_volume_name
options.description: Defines to rename virtual volume name

options.name: remote_access
options.description: Defines remote access to virtual volume

options.name: ssl_ca_cert
options.description: SSL CA certificate file (.pem format) provided by the user to verify SSL

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the volume should exist or not

options.name: supporting_device_name
options.description: Unique name of the supporting device. Over which Virtual volume should be created

options.name: verifycert
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. True - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. False - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: virtual_volume_id
options.description: Unique ID of the virtual volume or volume system_id virtual_volume_name is mutually exclusive with virtual_volume_id

options.name: virtual_volume_name
options.description: Unique name of the virtual volume virtual_volume_id is mutually exclusive with virtual_volume_name

options.name: vplex_timeout
options.description: the network connectivity timeout value to connect to VPLEX host in seconds

options.name: vplexhost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the VPLEX host

options.name: vplexpassword
options.description: the password of the VPLEX host.

options.name: wait_for_rebuild
options.description: Defines whether creation of virtual volume can proceed on rebuilding device or not
